name: Rocco Forte House, Milan
positioning: Serviced apartments with a House Concierge in a 19th century palazzo on Via Manzoni, at the corner of Via della Spiga in the Quadrilatero della Moda
best_for: Travelers who want an apartment with its own kitchen in Milan's fashion district
Families or groups wanting interconnecting apartments with three bedrooms
Guests who want a private chef or personal butler on request

facts.text: Rocco Forte House is a 19th century Milanese palazzo on Via Manzoni, on the corner of Via della Spiga.
The house is in the Quadrilatero della Moda, Milan's fashion neighbourhood.
The house is moments from Teatro alla Scala and Palazzo Orsini.
Original design details such as mouldings, frescoes and marble floors have been kept alongside modern comforts.
Each apartment has a sitting room, a dining room, a fully equipped kitchen and either one or two bedrooms.
There is a sub-level gym open 24/7.
A dedicated House Concierge handles housekeeping, grocery shopping, tours and reservations.
Tortona apartments have views of the Duomo and the city.
Bathrooms have skincare products by Irene Forte.
A welcome hamper of Italian specialties is given on arrival for stays of at least 7 nights.

highlights.text: The Brera apartments have original ceiling frescoes, restored.
The interiors were designed by Paolo Moschino Ltd in collaboration with Olga Polizzi, Director of Design at Rocco Forte Hotels.
Two apartments on the third floor can interconnect to form a three-bedroom space for larger groups and families.
A personal butler, private chef or event planning service is available on request.
Downstairs there is a traditional courtyard with a seating area filled with plants, open to all guests.

considerations.text: Breakfast is delivered to the apartment at a supplementary charge; a nanny service is also at a supplementary charge.
Only small pets under 6kg are welcome, with pet amenities at a supplementary charge.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
